query:
SELECT 
  'receivables' as source,
  id,
  saleId,
  originalAmount,
  paidAmount,
  remainingAmount,
  status,
  dueDate
FROM receivables 
WHERE customerId = (SELECT id FROM partners WHERE name LIKE '%Gabriel%' LIMIT 1)
  AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL')
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'sales' as source,
  s.id,
  NULL as saleId,
  s.finalAmount as originalAmount,
  NULL as paidAmount,
  NULL as remainingAmount,
  s.status,
  NULL as dueDate
FROM sales s
WHERE s.customerId = (SELECT id FROM partners WHERE name LIKE '%Gabriel%' LIMIT 1)
  AND s.saleType = 'A_PRAZO'
  AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY source, id
